entries.3464401bc057b25e: For dismantling and maintenance work on all plants, including steelworks, power stations and oil refining facilities, and general buildings such as condominiums and high-rise buildings, the company provides engineering services including construction method proposals, design, supervision, construction management, safety management and administrative response. The company handles removal of hazardous substances such as PCB, asbestos and dioxins, and contaminated soil improvement, using patented methods such as the “Apple Peeling Method” and “Windmill Toppling Method”; construction is outsourced to specialized subcontractors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥10,818 million.
